answer_1.quote: Large-scale language models (LLMs) have shown impressive results across a variety of natural language processing (NLP) applications.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates outputs in tasks such as long-context language modeling (via perplexity), passkey retrieval (accuracy in retrieving a token from long sequences), and benchmark evaluations (e.g., ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA).

answer_2.quote: We make a comparison of the long sequence language modeling performance using the perplexity metric.
